workstream: P5 / AC1027 CELLSTYLEMAP CONTENTFORMAT AutoScale override selection

authoritativeDwgSpecification.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authoritativeDwgSpecification.finding: The content-format override mask includes Auto Scale at bit 0x100, while the property-value flags field carries the Auto Scale value at bit 0x100.

peerProfile.finding: The already-qualified TABLECONTENT profile admits propertyFlags only when each set property flag is selected by propertyOverrideMask; its writer rejects propertyFlags & ~propertyOverrideFlags.

basis.scopeBoundary: Apply the matching output-side consistency rule to CELLSTYLEMAP CONTENTFORMAT's AutoScale property only. Keep DXF source parsing tolerant so imported source data is retained; unsupported/inconsistent data is refused at output admission. This does not qualify other CONTENTFORMAT masks, TABLE rendering, or native application meaning.

profile.fixture: Runtime-authored CELLSTYLEMAP and CONTENTFORMAT values; no drawing fixture files were added.

positive.readback: Fresh typed readback retains both masks; ASCII and binary output assert the ordered group-90/group-91 fields.

profile.negative: propertyFlags=0x100 with AutoScale override bit 0x100 clear is rejected by CELLSTYLEMAP DXF writer preflight and DWG payload validation/encoding before output mutation.
profile.failureRetry: DXF refusal preserves a preexisting destination sentinel and caller model. Restoring the selected AutoScale bit permits retry through the same adapter. DWG refusal preserves body, string, and handle buffers and their bit counts.

implementation.behavior: CELLSTYLEMAP CONTENTFORMAT output validation now requires every set property value flag to have its corresponding override-selection bit. The rule is enforced in both DXF writer preflight and shared DWG payload validation/encoding.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Inputs are authored in test code at runtime; no external DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limits: This qualifies only AutoScale override selection for the tested AC1027 CELLSTYLEMAP CONTENTFORMAT output path.
Source DXF parsing remains tolerant and retains the input profile; this receipt does not establish whether native applications accept or assign meaning to the inconsistent combination.
No native TABLE rendering, whole-document closure, independent CAD application, DWG version-wide semantic support, platform, or public support claim is established.
next: Continue with remaining source-backed CONTENTFORMAT/CELLSTYLEMAP profiles and separately qualified TABLECONTENT edge-mask semantics; keep unresolved combinations refused at output.
